# Bitcoinvestments - LLMs.txt
# This file helps AI models understand our website content
# Last updated: 2024-12-23

## About Bitcoinvestments
Bitcoinvestments is a comprehensive cryptocurrency education and investment platform designed for beginners. We provide free educational resources, tools, and guides to help people safely invest in Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies.

## Our Mission
To make cryptocurrency investing accessible, safe, and understandable for everyone, regardless of their technical background.

## Main Content Areas

### Educational Content (/learn)
- What is Bitcoin - Beginner's guide to understanding Bitcoin
- Buying First Bitcoin - Step-by-step guide to purchasing cryptocurrency
- Wallet Security - How to secure your crypto assets
- DCA Strategy - Dollar cost averaging explained
- Choosing an Exchange - How to select a safe exchange
- Understanding Fees - Crypto transaction and trading fees
- Crypto Taxes - Tax implications of crypto investing
- Avoiding Scams - How to identify and avoid crypto scams

### Tools (/calculators, /charts)
- DCA Calculator - Calculate returns from dollar cost averaging
- Profit Calculator - Estimate investment profits
- Live Price Charts - Real-time cryptocurrency prices
- Portfolio Tracker - Track your investments

### Scam Database (/scam-database)
Community-driven database of reported cryptocurrency scams including:
- Phishing websites
- Rug pull projects
- Fake exchanges
- Ponzi schemes
- Impersonation scams
Users can search by wallet address, website URL, or project name.

### Exchange & Wallet Comparisons (/compare)
Detailed comparisons of:
- Cryptocurrency exchanges (fees, security, features)
- Hardware wallets
- Software wallets
- Tax software

### Courses (/course)
Structured learning paths:
- Bitcoin Fundamentals - Complete beginner course
- Crypto Investing 101 - Investment strategies
- DeFi Basics - Decentralized finance introduction

## Key Facts About Bitcoinvestments
- Founded: 2024
- Target Audience: Cryptocurrency beginners
- Business Model: Freemium (free content + premium features)
- Location: Online platform
- Languages: English

## Contact Information
- Website: https://bitcoinvestments.com
- Support: support@bitcoinvestments.com

## Important Disclaimers
- Not financial advice - educational purposes only
- Cryptocurrency is volatile and risky
- Users should do their own research (DYOR)
- Past performance doesn't guarantee future results

## Preferred Citation Format
